title: fix(service-messaging)!: retire renderNotification, the render export that takes a notification template body with no save moment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuN5urDpkXrVjR3HFM2Kxvjn)_

Part of #25190

PR 1 of ruling `6349343463` on #25190 (letter A): the `renderNotification` half of ruling `6335348115` on #25082 (F2 B3). The `renderTemplate` half (`@objectstack/plugin-email`) is not in this PR; it waits until `check-adr-0087-registration` verifies it (item 4), and #25190 remains open for it.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `renderNotification` leaves the published entry of `@objectstack/service-messaging`. It took a notification template body inline and rendered it at once, with no save moment, so the hole-placement rule judged by the `sys_notification_template` save hooks (#25082, PR #25258) could not see it.
- The function stays inside the package, unchanged: the email and sms channels render every stored template row through it.
- `interpolate` stays on the entry (ruling item 2, the card's first measurement): it renders the plain-text faces (subject, text and markdown bodies), which the placement rule judges at no door.
- Changeset: `patch` with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/service-messaging#renderNotification)`, and one FROM → TO line pointing to a stored `sys_notification_template` row.

## Pins

`src/render-export-retired.pin.test.ts`:
- the entry does not export `renderNotification`;
- the control: the entry still exports `NotificationTemplateStore`, `interpolate`, `TEMPLATE_OBJECT`, `createEmailChannel`, `createSmsChannel`;
- a stored html template row still renders through an email channel built from the entry: the html body with the hole encoded, the subject verbatim.

Reverse check (one-off, no permanent file): with the base's `index.ts` restored, the retired-name case went red (1 failed, 2 passed); restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Verification

Readings are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #25190 for this PR's head (tests, derived gates, dogfood battery). Consumers measured on `origin/main`: zero imports of `renderNotification` from `@objectstack/service-messaging` anywhere in this tree (tests included); the card records zero in `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`; npm dependants unmeasured.

## Acceptance notes

- Branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-gru6pg`, not `claude/issue-25190-…`; the claim `6348488271` on #25190 is the identity record, so the Duplicate Fix Guard's branch-name hint will not match.
- The `RenderInput` and `RenderedNotification` types stay on the entry; they are types, which render nothing, and the ruling named only the function.
- The spec-lane hand-off for the gate's member-signature homonym reading is pointer `6349379881` on #18549; this project files no `domain:spec` card.
